title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 17, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $4,000.00
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 17, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $4,000.00
  for the West Valley Area Summer Picnic, as set forth.  [BPC #26-357]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and ACCEPT the donation.
